'''2001 Quebec Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship held in Montreal, Quebec on 29 April 2001. Raphael won it. It is known from Maxim Briand's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2218">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-02-montreal-provincial-29-04-01d2218/ montreal-provincial-29-04-01], DeckTech (maxim "Burnt toast" briand, 2 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-02-montreal-provincial-29-04-01d2218/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Montreal, Quebec
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 50
* '''Winner:''' Raphael
